title: Floating Chat Widget - Modern Web Messenger
description:
A sleek, responsive floating chat widget for websites that allows users to send and receive messages in real-time. This interactive UI component features a toggleable chat interface with message bubbles, timestamps, and a modal for additional functionality. Perfect for customer support, live chat, or community engagement on any website.

Key Features

  • Floating Chat Button: Persistent, eye-catching button that expands into a chat window

  • Message Interface: Clean, organized chat bubbles with sent/received styling

  • Responsive Design: Works on desktop and mobile devices

  • Modal Popup: Additional space for forms, information, or customization

  • Modern UI: Smooth animations, subtle shadows, and polished interactions
shortDescription: A lightweight, customizable floating chat widget with a toggleable interface and modal extension. Built with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—no jQuery required.
